note: Pins for the released seed assets (GitHub release assets, never git history). Rebuild with revtool.py seed build from the maintainer overlay DBs; seed verify checks a download against these pins, the target binary's hash, and the .text run scan. Each asset's builds pins every verified build of its target (#4467): the first build is the one the seed describes. A build whose text_sha256 matches the seed build's is byte-identical in .text and takes the seed unchanged; a build with an offsets table takes the seed with its function addresses translated; a build with neither is known but unmapped - revtool names it and says what to do instead of refusing silently. A build whose hash is not recorded yet keeps binary_sha256 null (a slot, never a guess).
